title: House Journey Thread / Path Memory Contract
purpose: Remember the reader's traversed spatial centers so the Potato House feels like a journey through a graph rather than a stateless menu.

storage.note: Journey history is private navigation state in the visitor's browser. It is not evidence, canon, user profiling, or a repository record.

bead_types.meaning: A spatial center or elevator stop the reader occupied.
The reader exited the spatial projection through a Door to a readable public page.
The reader used a plane landmark such as Roots, Ash, Swamp or Forge.

behavior: Consecutive duplicate states collapse into one bead.
Entering a Dwelling or nested Room appends a bead.
Cross-Dwelling wormhole traversal appends the destination Room while preserving its parent identity.
Moving Heaven/World/Below appends a Door/Axis level bead.
Opening a readable room may append a read bead pointing back to the spatial state from which it was opened.
Back through thread restores the prior spatial state without creating a duplicate bead.
Clicking an earlier bead returns to that recorded center without changing knowledge ownership.
Clear thread deletes only local navigation memory.
Each newly recorded spatial bead derives a transition type from the prior bead.
Journey UI may expose a short transition reason and replay the route step-by-step.
Replay never writes duplicate beads or changes canonical content.
semantic_rule: The trail records the route the reader took, not the only valid route through the House.
visual_rule: Render the journey as a connected thread/chain of beads. Current position is emphasized; wormhole or read exits may receive distinct labels, but color must not be the only status signal.

transition_types.meaning: Initial position in the remembered journey.
Door / Axis or another context recentered into a canonical Dwelling.
Movement between a Dwelling and one of its nested Rooms, or between nested Rooms in the same Dwelling.
Direct registered passage between nested Rooms belonging to different Dwellings.
Vertical movement between Heaven, World and Below projections.
Exit through a plane landmark such as Roots, Ash, Swamp or Forge.
Exit from spatial navigation into a readable public surface.
Movement outward toward parent Dwelling or Door / Axis.

narrative.rule: Every bead should be able to answer: where did I arrive, what kind of threshold did I cross, and why is this destination relevant from the prior center?
narrative.derived_reasoning: Transition reasons are derived from registered Room purpose/local-role/adjacency and plane descriptions, not invented claims about causation.
narrative.replay: The UI may replay remembered beads in sequence. Replay restores navigation states only; it must not generate new journey history.
